terms.title: Terms of Service

terms.s1Content: Minecraft Stats provides an analytics and tracking platform for public Minecraft servers. We gather, aggregate, and display statistics (such as player counts and server status) for informational purposes.
terms.s2Content: To access certain features, you must register for an account. We use Clerk as our secure authentication provider. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activities that occur under your account. You must notify us immediately of any unauthorized use.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.p1: This Privacy Policy explains how Minecraft Stats (we, our or us) collects, uses and protects information about you when you use our website. The data controller is {{ownerName}}, reachable at {{contactEmail}}.
privacy.s1Content: We collect information that you provide directly to us, such as when you create an account, update your profile, or communicate with us. Since we use Clerk for our authentication system, your registration information (like email address, username, and password) is securely processed and managed by Clerk.
privacy.s2Content: When you access the service, we automatically process technical data that is strictly necessary to operate it: IP address, browser type and server logs. This data is used solely to keep the site secure and available and to prevent abuse. We also use Umami, a privacy-friendly analytics tool: it sets no cookie, identifies no individual and performs no cross-site tracking.
privacy.s3Content: The site sets no advertising cookie and uses no third-party tracker for commercial purposes. Only cookies that are strictly necessary to the service are present: a theme preference cookie (light/dark) and a language cookie, both required for the site to work and kept for 1 year. You can delete them at any time from your browser settings without losing any functionality. Umami analytics runs without cookies.
privacy.s4Content: We do not sell or rent your personal data. Only technical providers strictly necessary for the service can access it: Clerk (authentication), Umami (anonymous analytics) and our host {{hostName}}. These providers are bound by contractual confidentiality obligations and use this data solely to operate the service.
privacy.s5Content: We take reasonable measures to help protect your personal information from loss, theft, misuse, unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, and destruction. However, please understand that no internet transmission is 100% secure.
privacy.s6Content: Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection and portability of your data. To exercise them, contact us at {{contactEmail}}. You may also lodge a complaint with your local supervisory authority.
privacy.s7Content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. If we make material changes, we will notify you by updating the date at the top of this policy and, in some cases, providing additional notice.
